editionLabel: Cocktail Games / Pegasus English base booklet v1.0 (2024)
firstPlayerRule: For the first mission, designate the Captain at random. The Captain takes the first turn, then play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: For subsequent missions, the Captain responsibility passes to the player on the left before setup.
This answer covers the first mission of a new game, not the restart procedure after a failed mission.
